title: Thisobald's Brewed-Up Bellyglummer
summary: Coat weapons to apply a debilitating poison on a failed DC 17 Constitution save.

fields.Coat: Bonus Action, single use. Coat the active weapon set for 10 turns. On hit, DC 17 Constitution save prevents Brewed-Up Bellyglummer. This bottle does not spread the effect when thrown.
fields.Poison: The target has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and takes 1d6 Poison at the end of its next turn. A successful save does not grant temporary inoculation, so you can try again that turn. Damage applies at most once per turn.
fields.Alchemy: Extract three Corpse Roses into Salts of Corpse Rose. Add any Suspension. First craft grants Notes of an Amateur to Criminals and Special Iced Arsenic… Brew? to Guild Artisans.
fields.Reported interactions: Even a successful save can trigger the hidden application interaction with Boots of Stormy Clamour, Coldbrim Hat, or Diadem of Arcane Synergy.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
